data.name: MWG_001
data.value: The summit...[pause=15] We're almost there.

data.name: MWG_002
data.value: Look at the sky...[pause=15] Those clouds aren't normal.

data.name: MWG_004
data.value: It is...[pause=15] Tornadus.[pause=20] The spirit of the winds.

data.name: MWG_005
data.value: I am the Breath that guards the summit...

data.name: MWG_006
data.value: Who are you?[pause=15] Show yourself![pause=10] We do not run.

data.name: MWG_007
data.value: I am this mountain's ultimate guardian.[pause=20] I have ruled these skies since long before anyone set foot on this land.

data.name: MWG_008
data.value: If you triumph here, the path to the ancestral ruins will open to you.

data.name: MWG_009
data.value: Fail...[pause=30] and your journey ends here.

data.name: MWG_010
data.value: Then let's show it our journey is just beginning![pause=10] {0}, let's do this!

data.name: MWG_011
data.value: This time, we take it down.[pause=15] I promise, {0}.

data.name: MWG_017
data.value: I hold nothing back...

data.name: MWG_018
data.value: But today's prey is tomorrow's hunter.

data.name: MWG_019
data.value: Rest now.[pause=30] The summit will wait for you.

data.name: MWG_021
data.value: Tornadus raises one hand.[pause=15] The whole sky leans with it.

data.name: MWG_023
data.value: It rises back into the storm with two wingbeats.[pause=20] The mountain still trembles.

data.name: MWG_030
data.value: That storm isn't weather. It's been waiting for us.

data.name: MWG_031
data.value: Whatever lands here, we don't run. Agreed?

data.name: MWG_032
data.value: Agreed. Though my legs may need convincing.

data.name: MWG_033
data.value: I remember a sky without climbers in it.

data.name: MWG_034
data.value: Then it's had a long time to get used to disappointment.

data.name: MWG_R01
data.value: The wind is still just as sharp up here.[pause=20] But the sky is empty.

data.name: MWG_R02
data.value: (No shadow crossing the sun.[pause=15] No cry against the rock.)

data.name: MWG_R03
data.value: He must be nesting higher up now.[pause=20] Somewhere we'll never reach.

data.name: MWG_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: MWG_038
data.value: I saw you from the ridge.[pause=25] Two specks, climbing badly.

data.name: MWG_039
data.value: I have watched this land from above since before it had roads.

data.name: MWG_040
data.value: From up there you stop seeing places.[pause=25] You start seeing shapes.

data.name: MWG_041
data.value: And there is a shape under your world, little ones.[pause=30] It has corners.

data.name: MWG_042
data.value: Nothing natural has corners.

data.name: MWG_043
data.value: I have carried that on my back for a very long time.[pause=30] Show me you can carry it too.

data.name: MWG_A01
data.value: ...You are far more powerful than I imagined.

data.name: MWG_A02
data.value: I never attacked explorers for pleasure. Understand me well.

data.name: MWG_A03
data.value: For weeks now, an unusual agitation has been sweeping the whole region.

data.name: MWG_A04
data.value: The winds have grown unstable. The air currents shift without warning.

data.name: MWG_A05
data.value: Wild Pokémon grow more aggressive. Even the mountains... seem to tremble.

data.name: MWG_A06
data.value: As guardian of the skies, I thought these disturbances came from the expeditions held here.

data.name: MWG_A07
data.value: So I decided to stop anyone from reaching this summit.

data.name: MWG_A08
data.value: But after facing you... I understand you are not responsible.

data.name: MWG_A09
data.value: ...A... legendary Pokémon.

data.name: MWG_A11
data.value: If our Guild truly is responsible for the troubles shaking this mountain...

data.name: MWG_A12
data.value: ...then we offer our apologies. Our only goal is to protect this region.

data.name: MWG_A13
data.value: We never wished to disturb its balance.

data.name: MWG_A15
data.value: You are not responsible.

data.name: MWG_A16
data.value: The disturbances are far older than your Guild.

data.name: MWG_A17
data.value: Something is gradually upsetting this region's natural balance. Even I don't know its cause.

data.name: MWG_A18
data.value: I merely read these events the wrong way.

data.name: MWG_A19
data.value: If even Tornadus doesn't know the origin of the disturbances... then this problem exceeds everything we imagined.

data.name: MWG_A20
data.value: Thank you for agreeing to speak with us, despite our clash.

data.name: MWG_A21
data.value: This goes far beyond a simple exploration mission.

data.name: MWG_A22
data.value: ...I already have three historical theories in mind. None is reassuring.

data.name: MWG_A23
data.value: If these disasters keep intensifying... I worry most about the people of Metano Town.

data.name: MWG_A24
data.value: We'll find a solution. We've seen worse.

data.name: MWG_A25
data.value: ...The situation is getting worrying. I'll only say it once.

data.name: MWG_A26
data.value: At least, if the sky falls, my wool will make an excellent lightning rod!

data.name: MWG_A27
data.value: Woof... I... I just talked to a legendary Pokémon. Well, he talked. I mostly listened.

data.name: MWG_A28
data.value: Incredible... incredible... incredible!

data.name: MWG_A29
data.value: I talked to a true legendary Pokémon!

data.name: MWG_A30
data.value: This journal chapter will be fantastic!

data.name: MWG_A31
data.value: You have proven your worth.

data.name: MWG_A32
data.value: Continue your journey. The answers you seek lie further ahead...

data.name: MWG_A33
data.value: Take care of your own.

data.name: MWG_A34
data.value: Farewell... and good luck for what comes next.

data.name: MWG_A35
data.value: ...We really just met a legendary Pokémon.

data.name: MWG_A37
data.value: So... when do we eat?

data.name: MWG_A38
data.value: Do you think he dropped a feather somewhere?

data.name: MWG_A39
data.value: I should have asked for an autograph...

data.name: MWG_A40
data.value: ...and that's when he said 'farewell and good luck', a great moment in Guild history...

data.name: MWG_A41
data.value: Do you at least realize what just happened?

data.name: MWG_A42
data.value: The whole Guild bursts out laughing. The tension drops in an instant.

data.name: MWG_A43
data.value: We've already lost a lot of time.

data.name: MWG_A44
data.value: The Shattered Ruins are just behind this mountain.

data.name: MWG_A45
data.value: Our mission isn't over.

data.name: MWG_A46
data.value: In formation. Let's move.
